title: Front License Plate Placement
summary: This topic mostly contains sparse or context-limited comments about front license plate mounting and a separate exhaust-package remark, with one clearly positive reaction praising the grille design over the plate holder placement.

positive.summary: The positive review values the grille lighting enough to object to a front plate holder blocking it.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined reviews mention unclear reasons, a request for a louder exhaust package, active work on a feature, and difficulty mounting a front license plate, but the examples are too fragmentary to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: The topic mixes front license plate placement and mounting with an unrelated exhaust-package comment.
Most examples are short or context-limited fragments, so the underlying customer stance is often unclear.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews on this topic.
